text:
Ana Park: Quick sync — we need lab access + final announce plan for the Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus bundle. Who owns the soak test and the embargo window?
Devin Li: I can own the soak tests. quick status: connector build passes unit CI but integration fails on Databricks runtime mismatch.
Elaine Wu: AH — which runtime? we updated the Databricks job to 13.1 last week.
Devin Li: Looks like the marketplace package still pins 12.x. Repro steps: 
```
dbx-run --cluster-runtime 13.1 --job connector-integration
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/connectors/snowbridge/health
```
Miguel Santos: For Milvus perf on the DGX test node, firmware v2.4 is required. HW partner (AuroraEdge) confirmed nodes shipped but we need the firmware image. Pinged them yesterday.
Jen Carter: Marketing needs final blurb + embargo date by EOD Wednesday. They want a 48h embargo before outward PR and partner quotes.
Ana Park: OK — proposed timeline: finish soak by Tuesday EOD, internal knockouts Wed morning, announce Thurs (embargo Wed-Fri). Does that work?
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing review due in 3 days. Checklist: docs, security scan, manifest, smoke tests.
Elaine Wu: Timeline tight. Can we reduce soak window if we run parallel smoke lanes? I can spin a Snowflake nightly job to validate connectors against sample datasets.
Devin Li: That helps. I'll run parallel lanes: (1) Databricks integration, (2) Snowflake ingest + query perf, (3) Milvus index + recall. Need creds: who has Snowflake sandbox creds?
Miguel Santos: I have the Snowflake sandbox user but need config for delta-copy job. Sending creds via 1:1. Also ask AuroraEdge to push firmware to DGX-3 by EOD today.
Ana Park: Action items:
- Devin: run parallel soak lanes and post failures to this thread (owner).
- Elaine: spin Snowflake nightly and add the sample dataset (owner).
- Miguel: confirm firmware push + Milvus perf run (owner).
- Jen: draft marketing blurb + embargo logistics; coordinate partner quotes (owner).
- Ana: coordinate joint announcement timing and signoff doc; will draft an internal checklist and share.
Devin Li: Starting soak now. Posting first failure: Databricks job fails with "Unsupported library: ml-ops v0.9". Tagging @Elaine for runtime check.
Elaine Wu: That library is optional; we'll fallback to runtime shim. Patching the marketplace package now. Expect patch in ~2h.
Jen Carter: Draft blurb (WIP): "Redwood Inference announces joint connector bundle with AuroraEdge and Milvus to accelerate vector search at scale across Snowflake and Databricks. Early customers report 3x faster query latencies in alpha tests." Thoughts? need partner quotes.
Miguel Santos: Suggest change: mention "DGX-optimized performance" and call out "hardware-validated" instead of generic "at scale".
Ana Park: Good call. Also we need legal signoff on partner quote usage — pinging legal separately.
marketplace-bot: FYI: security scan shows low-severity advisory in dependency chain (protobuf v3.8). Please raise if it blocks publish.
Devin Li: Acknowledged. I'll triage protobuf patch; plan to vendor-fix it in the connector package.
Ana Park: Final check tomorrow 10am PT for go/no-go. If any critical failures before then, post here. Otherwise Jen will lock embargo and we proceed with partner coordination. :thumbsup:
